clubs.name: Paris Saint-Germain
clubs.report: Paris Saint-Germain is rated from the French league level, then from the Champions League matches already played. European titles and the five-year coefficient are not a strength bonus. Prediction markets put them at 17.6% to win the title. The last 6 matches (goals adj) average 2.25 goals for and 1.062 against, with Champions League games counted twice and domestic games counted once. They have played 5 times in the last 28 days (Champions League, Ligue 1). Goal rates are trimmed to 0.988. The injury feed has no confirmed absences on this run. The simulations finish 12.5 points above that market price.
